description.zh: 提供股票或相关证券的分红事件数据，包括分红方案日期、除权除息日、派息日和每股分红金额等信息

optional.name: announcement_date
optional.description: Date when the dividend plan or event was announced

optional.name: record_date
optional.description: Record date used to determine eligible holders

optional.name: payment_date
optional.description: Date when the dividend is paid

optional.name: gross_amount
optional.description: Gross dividend amount before tax, if available

required.name: symbol
required.description: Security identifier of the affected instrument

required.name: effective_date
required.description: Effective event date, typically ex-dividend date or announced effective date

required.name: amount
required.description: Dividend amount per share or equivalent payout amount

optional.name: start_date
optional.description: Start date of dividend event search window in YYYY-MM-DD
optional.default_rationale: 默认拉过去 12 个月分红记录（≈1 年）

optional.name: end_date
optional.description: End date of dividend event search window in YYYY-MM-DD

optional.name: market
optional.description: Target market code for routing, e.g. US, CN, HK

required.name: symbol
required.description: Security identifier of the affected instrument
